NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Psst! uses your location to find nearby supermarkets when you run a search.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you turn on reminders, Psst! notifies you when you pass near a supermarket, even when the app is closed. Your location stays on your iPhone.
